Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: Changed: the Appearance page is now organized in four tabs (Window, Colors, Shape and Behavior). Added: a color for the gradient of the bars (white by default). Added: the thickness of the borders, one setting for bars and one for icons (0 to 3 px). Added: units that are out of reach fade in the party list, the target, the focus, the enmity list and the nameplates: allies beyond 30 yalms and enemies beyond 25, or out of sight, as the game itself says. You can choose frames, nameplates, both or none. Added: the leader icon of the party in the party list, with its size and position in the Party options. Changed: new look for the Black Mage auras (Firestarter, Paradox and Thunderhead): glowing, semi-transparent energy instead of the old drawings. Fixed: the party list now hides when you are alone and the game is set not to show its own list alone (the preview of the Party page and unlock mode still show it)
